newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KONDOR SAYS ELEVELD TO TAKE STAKE IN GIERVELD UNIT.
newsitem.headline: KONDOR SAYS ELEVELD TO TAKE STAKE IN GIERVELD UNIT.

text.p: Construction group Kondor Wessels said on Wednesday it was close to reaching agreement with Eleveld Beheer BV on Eleveld's participation in Kondor's interior finishing unit Gierveld Afwerking BV of Rijssen.
Gierveld's activities are focused on constructing and tiling interior walls. The company posts annual turnover of some 10 million guilders.
Eleveld Afbouw, Eleveld Beheer's interior finishing unit, books annual turnover of some five million guilders and is active mainly in plastering.
Kondor Wessels said the bundling of the two companies' expertise would lead to a broader range of services, enabling them to expand their markets.
